what: User correction 2026-04-21 on class-of-issue fixes: when fixing a validation-type/schema/contract issue for ONE tool or entry point, audit the entire class for the same issue in the same pass. Don't fix just the one instance and ship — if aide_recall had z.number() → z.coerce.number() applied, every other MCP tool with a numeric param (aide_update id, aide_forget id, aide_search limit, aide_memories limit) should have gotten the same fix at the same time. Filing each one as a separate follow-up later when someone hits the bug is wasteful and burns user trust. Rule: when a fix is "change pattern X everywhere it applies," grep for X and update all sites in one pass. Specifically for MCP tool schemas: check all `z.number()`, `z.string()`, etc. for whether coercion or validation should be consistent.
why: User explicitly corrected: "whoever fixed the issue for one of the tool calls didnt think to fix for the other tool calls?? like cmon". Captures the principle so future fixes to schema/validation/contract-type issues audit all peers in the same pass. priority: always so it injects at SessionStart for every future session.
